title: pdf_prebake_test re-implements skip_if_no_typst/typst_available/priv_dir already in audit_report_test instead of the shared test_helpers module
evidence: pdf_prebake_test.gleam:309 `fn skip_if_no_typst() -> Bool {` / :327 `@external(erlang, "ai@audit_report_ffi", "available")` `fn typst_available() -> Bool` / :332 `fn priv_dir() -> String {` duplicates audit_report_test.gleam:19 `fn skip_if_no_typst() -> Bool {` / :37 `@external(erlang, "ai@audit_report_ffi", "available")` `fn typst_available() -> Bool` / :39 `fn priv_dir() -> String {` — only the panic/log message strings differ (`panic as "pdf_prebake_test: typst CLI missing in CI — install step in test.yml is broken"` vs `panic as "audit_report_test: typst CLI missing in CI — install step in test.yml is broken"`). A shared module exists: server/test/test_helpers.gleam line 1 `//// Shared test factories and helpers used across server test modules.`, already imported by unit tests (e.g. test/ai/ai_client_test.gleam, test/application/form_view_test.gleam).
detail: AGENTS.md: extract helpers when logic repeats 2+ places. Four test helpers now exist in two copies; a third typst-dependent test would copy them again, and a fix (e.g. skip-behaviour change) must be applied twice.
recommended_fix: Move skip_if_no_typst, typst_available, priv_dir and the normalize_metadata external into test/test_helpers.gleam (panic message passed as an argument) and import it from both test modules.

title: Redundant no-op `let _ = application_id` in payload_for
detail: The parameter is already used in the list.find closure, so the `let _ = application_id` statement suppresses nothing — it is a pure no-op line, contrary to the no-dead-code rule.
recommended_fix: Delete the `let _ = application_id` line, keeping only `panic as "demo payload missing"` in the Error branch.
